build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone model with specified depth for image feature extraction
create_basicblock_residual: create a BasicBlock residual unit with two 3x3 convolutions and skip connection
create_bottleneck_residual: create a Bottleneck residual unit with 1x1-3x3-1x1 convolutions and skip connection
build_reslayer_stage: build a ResLayer stage with multiple residual blocks and optional downsampling
get_expansion_ratio: get the expansion ratio for a given residual block class type
